item.title: Apple AirPods 5 Set for September 9 Reveal Launch
item.description: Apple is poised to unveil two new AirPods 5 models on September 9, offering both ANC and non‑ANC options. Explore the tech, pricing, and impact.

item.title: Apple May Unveil Two New AirPods 5 Models Next Month

item.description: Apple’s B790 AirPods embed a tiny camera, delivering Visual Intelligence that scans objects, saves info via Siri, and could launch September 2026.

item.title: macOS Tahoe 26.7 Leak Shows Unreleased AirPods 5 Specs
item.description: macOS Tahoe 26.7 update references unreleased AirPods 5 models (B868M/E), hinting at new chip, ANC options, and potential Beats Solo Buds tie‑up.

item.title: AirPods With Cameras: Detailed Look at the New Leak

item.title: Apple’s Accidental AirPods Camera Leak Sparks AI Debate
item.description: A macOS Tahoe RC video unintentionally exposed camera‑enabled AirPods, letting Siri use visuals via Visual Intelligence to describe what you see.

item.title: Apple’s Camera AirPods Usher In Wearable Vision Era
item.description: Leaked macOS 26.7 RC footage shows Apple’s upcoming AirPods with a built‑in camera, using Visual Intelligence and Siri for a fresh wearable experience.

item.title: iOS 27 Introduces Custom Three‑Band EQ for AirPods
item.description: iOS 27 adds a device‑specific three‑band equalizer for AirPods Pro 2/3, AirPods 4 and AirPods Max 2, syncing settings across iPhone, iPad and Mac.
